title: unified rollouts: add configurable rollback thresholds and observability guards
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: improve safety and visibility for unified rollouts (canary, A/B, shadow) by making rollback thresholds configurable and adding observability guards to reduce noisy rollbacks. This PR introduces: 1) configurable threshold profiles for automatic rollback based on composite metrics (latency percentile, error-rate, quality-regression). 2) time-windowed metric aggregation and quorum logic so short spikes don't trigger rollbacks. 3) observability hooks: per-rollout telemetry tags, new rollout_health metrics, and dashboard panels for canary shadow comparisons. 4) stability guards and manual quarantine actions exposed in the Console API. 5) e2e stability tests and unit coverage for the autorollback engine. Checklist: - [x] design review (ENG-1423) - [x] implementation for rollback thresholds and quorum - [x] observability metrics + Grafana dashboard templates - [x] unit+e2e tests - [x] documentation updates in redwood-docs - [x] CI green and merge, backport plan prepared. Impact: no breaking API changes; rollout config adds optional fields and defaults to previous behavior. See linked Linear tasks for rollout policy rollout plan.

discussion: Diego: Can we avoid adding another global metric? Please prefer tagging existing metrics where possible. Author: We tagged the existing latency and error metrics with rollout_id and added a computed rollout_health metric that is derived from tagged metrics to simplify queries. Lina: Need to ensure defaults preserve current behavior for existing rollout manifests. Author: Defaults are nil/empty and the engine falls back to the legacy single-threshold behavior. Marcus: CI failed on the first run due to a race in engine_test; please add a short retry guard. Author: Added a deterministic waiter in engine_test and fixed the race. CI: granular checks failed (integration flaky test) after first push; re-run after fix and all checks passed. Diego: approve after minor nits addressed. Lina: approved. Marcus: approved. Maintainer: squashed and merged. Backport: prepared branch release/2026-02 for customers on Dedicated who requested the feature.
release_notes: Improved rollout safety and observability: added configurable rollback threshold profiles, time-windowed quorum logic to prevent noisy rollbacks, rollout_health telemetry and Console dashboards, and manual quarantine controls. Defaults preserve existing behavior.
notes_for_ops: Ops: recommend enabling the new rollout_health dashboard for high-traffic services and validating thresholds in staging with shadow traffic before enabling autorollback in production. Backport branch: release/2026-02. Run migrations: none.
qa_notes: Added e2e stability test that simulates a transient latency spike and verifies quorum prevents auto-rollback; added unit tests covering edge cases in quorum math.
